title: Fees and Charges
text:
NATIONAL INSURANCE COMMISSION
11 February 2026 Ref: PS/GN/HPS/DS/001
To: All Chief Executive Officers (Re) Insurance Companies and Intermediaries
Dear Sir/Madam,
NOTICE OF REVISED SCHEDULE OF FEES AND CHARGES
We write with reference to the above subject.
Pursuant to Section 32 of the Insurance Act, 2021 (Act 1061), which mandates all Insurers,
Reinsurers, and Intermediaries to pay for services rendered by the National Insurance
Commission (NIC), the Commission hereby issues a revised schedule of fees.
Please note that these approved fees were last reviewed in 2019. This adjustment is necessary
to align our regulatory charges with the current supervisory scope and prevailing economic
conditions.
Best regards.
Yours faithfully,
Dr. Abiba Zakariah
Ag. Commissioner of Insurance
NATIONAL INSURANCE COMMISSION
